lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਸਭੁ ਕੀਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kaa janam saphalio sabh keeaa karatai jin gur bachanee sach bhaakhiaa ||
lines.translation: The Creator makes fruitful the lives of all those who, through the Guru's Word, chant the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਨ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: te dha(n)n jan vad purakh poore jo guramat har jap bhau bikham tare ||
lines.translation: Blessed are those humble beings, those great and perfect people, who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Lord; they cross over the terrifying and treacherous world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sevak jan sevahi te paravaan jin seviaa guramat hare ||3||
lines.translation: Those humble servants who serve are accepted. They follow the Guru's Teachings, and serve the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too a(n)tarajaamee har aap jiu too chalaavahi piaare hau tivai chalaa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself, Lord, are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as You make me walk, O my Beloved, so do I walk.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਜਾ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਉ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamarai haath kichh naahi jaa too melahi taa hau aai milaa ||
lines.translation: Nothing is in my hands; when You unite me, then I come to be united.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau too har melahi suaamee sabh tin kaa lekhaa chhutak gaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those whom You unite with Yourself, O my Lord and Master - all their accounts are settled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਕਰਿਅਹੁ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee ganat na kariahu ko bhaaee jo gur bachanee har mel laiaa ||
lines.translation: No one can go through the accounts of those, O Siblings of Destiny, who through the Word of the Guru's Teachings are united with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਭਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daiaal hoaa tin oopar jin gur kaa bhaanaa ma(n)niaa bhalaa ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord shows Mercy to those who accept the Guru's Will as good.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਿਉ ਤੂ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: too a(n)tarajaamee har aap jiu too chalaavahi piaare hau tivai chalaa ||4||2||
lines.translation: You Yourself, Lord, are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as You make me walk, O my Beloved, so do I walk. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Tukhaari, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: too jagajeevan jagadees sabh karataa srisat naath ||
lines.translation: You are the Life of the World, the Lord of the Universe, our Lord and Master, the Creator of all the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਤੂ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਾਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin too dhiaaiaa meraa raam jin kai dhur lekh maath ||
lines.translation: They alone meditate on You, O my Lord, who have such destiny recorded on their foreheads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau dhur har likhiaa suaamee tin har har naam araadhiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are so pre-destined by their Lord and Master, worship and adore the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin ke paap ik nimakh sabh laathe jin gur bachanee har jaapiaa ||
lines.translation: All sins are erased in an instant, for those who meditate on the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਉ ਭਇਆ ਸਨਾਥੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dha(n)n te jan jin har naam japiaa tin dekhe hau bhaiaa sanaath ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings who meditate on the Lord's Name. Seeing them, I am uplifted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਸਭ ਕਰਤਾ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨਾਥੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too jagajeevan jagadees sabh karataa srisat naath ||1||
lines.translation: You are the Life of the World, the Lord of the Universe, our Lord and Master, the Creator of all the Universe. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too jal thal maheeal bharapoor sabh oopar saach dhanee ||
lines.translation: You are totally pervading the water, the land and the sky. O True Lord, You are the Master of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਘਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin japiaa har man cheet har jap jap mukat ghanee ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord in their conscious minds - all those who chant and meditate on the Lord are liberated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਊਜਲ ਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin japiaa har te mukat praanee tin ke oojal mukh har duaar ||
lines.translation: Those mortal beings who meditate on the Lord are liberated; their faces are radiant in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਰਖਨਹਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi halat palat jan bhae suhele har raakh leee rakhanahaar ||
lines.translation: Those humble beings are exalted in this world and the next; the Savior Lord saves them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਬਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sa(n)tasa(n)gat jan sunahu bhaaee guramukh har sevaa saphal banee ||
lines.translation: Listen to the Lord's Name in the Society of the Saints, O humble Siblings of Destiny. The Gurmukh's service to the Lord is fruitful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਧਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: too jal thal maheeal bharapoor sabh oopar saach dhanee ||2||
lines.translation: You are totally pervading the water, the land and the sky. O True Lord, You are the Master of all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: too thaan thana(n)tar har ek har eko ek raviaa ||
lines.translation: You are the One Lord, the One and Only Lord, pervading all places and interspaces.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਵਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: van trin tribhavan sabh srisat mukh har har naam chaviaa ||
lines.translation: The forests and fields, the three worlds and the entire Universe, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਚਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਗਣਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh chavahi har har naam karate asa(n)kh aganat har dhiaavae ||
lines.translation: All chant the Name of the Creator Lord, Har, Har; countless, uncountable beings meditate on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: so dha(n)n dhan har sa(n)t saadhoo jo har prabh karate bhaavae ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed are those Saints and Holy People of the Lord, who are pleasing to the Creator Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਫਲੁ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦ ਚਵਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so saphal darasan dehu karate jis har hiradai naam sad chaviaa ||
lines.translation: O Creator, please bless me with the Fruitful Vision, the Darshan, of those who chant the Lord's Name in their hearts forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਰਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: too thaan thana(n)tar har ek har eko ek raviaa ||3||
lines.translation: You are the One Lord, the One and Only Lord, pervading all places and interspaces. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਅਸੰਖ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree bhagat bha(n)daar asa(n)kh jis too devahi mere suaamee tis milahi ||
lines.translation: The treasures of devotional worship to You are countless; he alone is blessed with them, O my Lord and Master, whom You bless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਗੁਰ ਹਾਥੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਟਿਕਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kai masatak gur haath tis hiradai har gun tikahi ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Glorious Virtues abide within the heart of that person, whose forehead the Guru has touched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਟਿਕਹਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun hiradai tikahi tis kai jis a(n)tar bhau bhaavanee hoee ||
lines.translation: The Glorious Virtues of the Lord dwell in the heart of that person, whose inner being is filled with the Fear of God, and His Love.
